headline: Server and networking surge lifts profit; outlook raised
summary_short: HPE's quarter ended Oct. 31, 2026 had revenue of $14.5B, up 50% y/y, and non-GAAP EPS of $1.43, above its $1.20-$1.30 outlook. FY27 revenue is guided to $59.4B-$63.1B.
summary_long: Revenue rose 50% to $14.5B. Cloud & AI revenue was $11.3B (+68.6%, server +94.7%); Networking was $3.1B (+12.3%). Non-GAAP operating margin reached 16.9%, up 470bp y/y, while non-GAAP gross margin of 38.2% fell 220bp q/q. Free cash flow was $1.9B, flat y/y. FY27 outlook raised: non-GAAP EPS $5.05-$5.35; Q1 FY27 revenue $14.0B-$14.6B, non-GAAP EPS $1.30-$1.40.
confidence_notes: Period label mismatch: the shard labels this event FY2026 Q3, but the release is HPE's fiscal Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended Oct. 31, 2026); all figures come from the release. Gross margin figures are non-GAAP unless stated.

drivers.explanation: Cloud & AI revenue rose 68.6% with servers up 94.7%; Networking grew 12.3%, led by Campus & Branch up 16.7%. The CEO links results to AI infrastructure demand and the integration of its largest acquisition.
Cloud & AI segment operating margin was 18.4% versus 9.3% a year earlier; Networking margin slipped to 22.1% from 23.4%.
Management raised FY27 guidance, citing the durability of profitable growth.
